opening.argument: The speaker describes paying a $99 membership fee and $500 for a mining-pool share, then presents recurring daily earnings and reinvestment into more shares as the benefit. He reports earning about $1,100 in eight weeks and says viewers can recruit others to make substantially more, tying additional income to recruitment. This is not merely a description of mining: he emphasizes an unusually high daily return and directly invites viewers to contact him about the opportunity. Together, the payments, compounding income claims, recruitment pitch, and active invitation establish a paid mining-share solicitation presented as a way to earn money.
